dataset: ABA Standard 509 Required Disclosures — law school admissions data
source: American Bar Association Standard 509 Required Disclosures
license: Free to use with attribution. The underlying data is published by the American Bar Association.
notes: Null means the school did not report that field. It never means zero.
tuition is null for the 32 schools that report per-credit tuition; no annual total is inferred for them.
grant_band_* are the four mutually exclusive 509 aid bands; they do not reconcile exactly to grant_pct_receiving because each band is rounded separately upstream.
bar_ultimate_2023 and bar_ultimate_2024 are two-year passage rates for different graduating cohorts; bar_first_time_rate is the strict first-attempt rate. They are not interchangeable.
